# Enzo Norese — Backend Engineer & Cloud Architect

> Backend Engineer and Cloud Architect based in Santiago, Chile. Specialized in Azure serverless systems, integrations, migrations, and AI automation for real operations. Technical reference with hands-on implementation experience. Site available in English (/en) and Spanish (/es).

## About (English)

Enzo Norese is a Computer Engineer with an electronics background. He works across backend development and cloud architecture, turning operational needs into maintainable, observable systems. At TeamWork Capacitación Ltda. he acts as a technical reference while remaining hands-on with implementation.

His work includes recruitment platforms, ATS-connected campaign forms, WhatsApp support systems, Azure serverless architectures, and the Softland → Rex+ ERP migration. He treats AI as a capability multiplier without replacing analysis, security, or engineering accountability.

## Sobre mí (Español)

Enzo Norese es Ingeniero en Informática con base en electrónica. Trabaja entre el desarrollo backend y la arquitectura cloud, convirtiendo necesidades operativas en sistemas mantenibles y observables. En TeamWork Capacitación Ltda. se desempeña como referente técnico con participación directa en la implementación.

Su experiencia incluye plataformas de reclutamiento, formularios conectados a un ATS, atención por WhatsApp, arquitecturas serverless en Azure y la migración ERP Softland → Rex+. Usa la IA como multiplicador de capacidad sin reemplazar el análisis, la seguridad ni la responsabilidad de ingeniería.

## Stack / Tech

- Cloud: Microsoft Azure (Azure Functions, Service Bus, SignalR, Blob Storage, CosmosDB)
- Languages: TypeScript, Node.js, Python, C# / .NET Core
- Frontend: React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- Databases: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, CosmosDB, MongoDB, Redis
- DevOps: GitHub Actions, Docker, CI/CD
- Security: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT
- AI: Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini (multi-model orchestration)

## Key facts

- Role: Backend Engineer & Cloud Architect (technical reference / go-to engineer)
- Location: Santiago, Chile — available for remote work and international opportunities
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (professional)
